notes.title: EnHanced 2 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33745675/a1f6a8959135c513b99cb71f92fff4e573357923.gif[/img]

Heyo EnHancers, been a while huh?
Ain't it crazy EnHanced has been out for two entire years?! 🎉

A lot has happened in the world and I can only hope that's you're all keeping safe and I'm sure you're all doing your best, things'll improve! 💪

Big thanks to everyone that's checked EnHanced out, espesh those that reviewed it - it's great to get feedback! I'm hoping one day EnHanced'll have enough traction so all those great Cards, BGs and Emotes I've had waitin for years can be released!

Best of luck to everyone and let's hope 2021 will be the year stuff really starts to enhance for the world 🙏
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33745675/03fe5f7dbcbaec122352473569877ecc039a9647.gif[/img]

notes.title: Steam Cards and emotes all set up!
notes.content:
Yo EnHancers!

Finally got EnHanced's extra stuff done and all sorted in the Steam backend, once Steam thinks EnHanced should have cards etc then everyone can be rolling in trim!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745675/343cfdd29eb86a1138bf8625ea67b66239431041.png[/img]
Look at how snazzy this looks!

We got:
5 level badges and a foil badge
5 trading cards
9 backgrounds
10 emotes

Here's hoping you'll all be able to see them and have the chance to have them as your own soon, hope you've all had a great holiday and here's to us all having a great coming year!

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
That didn't take long!
Fixed a secret from not working when you pressed up in front of it, it should be all good now :OkaySir:

notes.title: EnHanced is out! (Properly)
notes.content:
Achem hi all again!
The Steam bug has been fixed so that EnHanced can now be bought, thank you all so much for being so patient!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745675/4f6ccad382ce461078c52c2dc72e6b9f13227738.png[/img]
(Fantastic artwork by hypoempathy on DeviantArt)

Let's hope that's the only bug for a while, cheers!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745675/03fe5f7dbcbaec122352473569877ecc039a9647.gif[/img]

notes.title: Store bug
notes.content:
Hi all!
It seems EnHanced can't be bought for some reason at the minute although the OST can be, I'm not sure why and I've contacted Steam about it, here's hoping to get it sorted ASAP!

EDIT: Over 6 hours later and still no word from Steam, sadly. It's 2:30am here so I need to sleep, please do click the Follow button above if you're interested in my game, I'll post an announcement like this when the game can be bought.

I'm very sorry about all this trouble, at least the GameJolt version is up and working fine!

Edit: It's all up and fixed now! :otrthumbup:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745675/03fe5f7dbcbaec122352473569877ecc039a9647.gif[/img]

notes.title: EnHanced released!
notes.content:
EnHanced is now up for sale!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33745675/03a4f13d76ccd6fbf7457fa540f7fedf2315c426.png[/img]

It's been a wild year this year and being able to finally release this game is certainly the highlight of it so far, I really hope you all enjoy it!
